script_text: This week the cosmos flips the script for Aries as Mars, your fire‑ruling planet, squares Saturn in Pisces while Venus ignites your third house of communication. Early week (Mon‑Wed) Mars in Leo forms a square to Saturn on Monday, making Tuesday the toughest day for career moves, but Wednesday’s Venus‑Mercury sextile in Gemini smooths love talks and opens doors. Mid‑week turning point arrives Thursday when the Sun enters Cancer, lighting your fourth house and triggering an emotional reset that reshapes home projects. Late week (Thu‑Sun) the Sun‑Jupiter trine in Cancer expands family finances, while Mars trines Uranus in Taurus on Saturday, sparking creative breakthroughs. Best day: Wednesday — Venus sextiles Mercury in your third house, boosting romance and contracts. Worst day: Monday — Mars squares Saturn, stalling professional momentum. Weekly advice: Schedule talks for Wednesday and protect Monday’s energy for routine tasks. Follow for daily updates.
